errors.evidence: The chart labels a category as 'Solid fossil fuels' (18.3%), which is a specific type of fossil fuel. The description incorrectly translates this as 'Всички изкопаеми горива' (All fossil fuels), which is inaccurate as 'Natural gas' and 'Crude oil' are also fossil fuels and are listed as separate categories.

The description identifies the chart on the right as a 'стълбовидна диаграма' (bar chart) but fails to mention that it is a stacked bar chart, which is a key structural feature showing the composition of renewable energy.
